# fox data API

<!-- generated by pipeline/build_api_doc.py from web/src/lib/schemas.json, pipeline/dag.py and the files under web/public/data; edit the script, not this file. The same content is the page /data/api. -->

fox publishes every figure it shows as static JSON under `https://fox-research-il.web.app/data/`. There is no server: a file is the API. Each family below has a path pattern, a data contract (JSON Schema in `/data/schemas.json`, checked on every build by `pipeline/check_schemas.py`), the pipeline step that writes it, how often it changes and the fields that carry its provenance (page, URL, report id).

## Terms

Free to use, including commercially. Cite fox (with a link to the page or file) and the primary source the record names: the MAYA filing and page, or the regulator's dataset. Fundamentals only: no share prices are published (the valuation pages take a manual price input). The files are static and refreshed by the pipeline; there is no key and no rate limit, but please cache: every file is served with a short max-age. No warranty: check the figure against the cited page before relying on it.

## Provenance fields

`pg` / `page`: the page in the source PDF · `u` / `url` / `urls`: the source file (a MAYA PDF, `#page=` jumps to the page) · `rid` / `r` / `report_id`: the MAYA report id (`https://maya.tase.co.il/he/reports/<id>`) · `doc` / `docs` / `files`: a document registry the rows index into · `src`: the source kind or URL · `std`: IFRS 4 / IFRS 17 · `cmp`: a comparative figure from a later report · `der`: derived (Q4 = FY − 9M) · `vint`: the vintages (every report that printed a figure) · `fetched` / `built` / `asof`: when it was read.

## Feeds and downloads

| Path | Format | What |
|---|---|---|
| `/feed.xml` | RSS 2.0 | the delta feed: every new filing figure, restatement, target, regulator month (feed.json as RSS) |
| `/feed.atom` | Atom | the same feed as Atom |
| `/feed/<company>.xml` | RSS 2.0 | one company's events (also .atom) |
| `/feed/months.xml` | RSS 2.0 | the regulator's monthly files as they land (also .atom) |
| `/feed/funds.xml` | RSS 2.0 | fund and track events (also .atom) |
| `/feed/market.xml` | RSS 2.0 | market-level events (also .atom) |
| `/data/calendar.ics` | iCalendar | every expected filing date (calendar.json as ICS) |
| `/data/cal/<company>.ics` | iCalendar | one company's expected filing dates |
| `/data/xlsx/<company>.xlsx` | XLSX | the model-ready workbook of a company: metrics x periods Q1'23 ... Q2'26 + FY, every value with its document, page and link (Sources sheet) |
| `/data/schemas.json` | JSON Schema | the data contracts: the schema of every contracted family below |

## Changelog

A breaking change (a key renamed or removed, a unit changed, a file moved) is listed here with its date; the contract in schemas.json changes in the same commit.

| Date | Kind | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-02 | added | xlsx/<company>.xlsx: one model-ready workbook per company (P&L, Balance sheet, IFRS 17, Solvency, Savings, KPIs, Sources). |
| 2026-11-02 | added | consensus.json: published sell-side price targets and recommendations, each with its source URL (schema `consensus`). |
| 2026-11-02 | added | This page and docs/API.md. No changelog was kept before this date: the contracts in schemas.json as of this date are the baseline. |
